points: High-risk use cases to migrate as early as possible, at the latest by end of 2030; migration largely complete by 2035
Addressed to federal, state and local government plus companies, including KRITIS operators
Asks for clear responsibilities, binding deadlines, quantum risk in risk management, early vendor involvement and crypto-agility
read: BSI press release of 12.10.2026 with link to the 'Leitlinie zur Umstellung auf PQC' PDF
take: Germany's first official national PQC migration guideline adopts the EU deadlines. CISOs and KRITIS operators now need named owners, binding dates and a crypto inventory.
title: BSI, BMI and BMDS: high-risk systems quantum-safe by end of 2030
